'''Red Team''' was a [[Flight group/Legends|flight]] of three [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighters]] assigned to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]-allied [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Isis/Legends|Isis]]. All three [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]], including their [[Red Team leader|leader]], were [[Death/Legends|killed]] in pursuit of the [[Imperial Survey Corps/Legends|Imperial Survey Corps]] [[Far*Reach IV PQR]] ''[[Wanderer]]'' over the planet.
